resources.string: Paste C codes and quantities, or read C codes, quantities and location IDs from XLSX.
Enter one C code and quantity per line, separated by spaces, commas or tabs. Text uses the location below. Quantities for the same code and location are combined. Review before confirming inbound.
C code and quantity (one pair per line)

Reads the first visible worksheet: column 1 C code, column 2 quantity, column 3 existing location ID. Blank locations use the selected location. Headers and blank rows are supported; up to 500 rows and 10 MiB. Quantities must be positive integers. Identical imports in the current batch are skipped.
Added %1$d items; skipped %2$d duplicates in this batch.
